name: Partner Tech Corp.
summary: Partner Tech Corp. is a global leader in the production and distribution of flexible, PC-driven point-of-sale (POS) systems and various associated peripheral devices. Their extensive POS product line encompasses desktop solutions such as fanless touch terminals, Android-based systems, transformable units, all-in-one models, and traditional PC POS products. They also offer innovative transformer POS systems and mobile POS solutions. Beyond their core POS offerings, the company provides kiosks, customer displays, LCD monitors, and digital signage products. Their peripheral range includes printers, scanners, cash management systems, I/O boxes, and keyboards. Furthermore, Partner Tech develops cloud-based device management platforms and specialized solutions tailored for smart restaurant operations. Partner Tech's solutions cater to a broad spectrum of industries, including stadiums and event venues, general retail, theater cinemas, cruise lines, and the broader hospitality sector. Established in 1990, the company is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, and functions as a subsidiary of Qisda Technology Co., Ltd.
